generation_ack_protocol.grant_identity: receiver-local membership generation plus flow ID
generation_ack_protocol.ack_semantics: a sender emits one ACK after applying a generation-tagged grant
generation_ack_protocol.retry_semantics: retry only unacknowledged flows in the current membership generation
generation_ack_protocol.terminal_condition: every membership batch is fully acknowledged and no grant ACK remains pending

selection_policy: Qualify the explicit generation-ACK mechanism on frozen seed 95 before opening the five-seed holdout. Do not inspect holdout performance until every holdout mechanism check passes, and do not alter the configuration after seeing holdout results.

scalability_holdout.required_control_frame_envelope: F_s(N) = grant sends + grant-ACK sends <= 3N for every coalesced seed and N

scope_limits: The pilot and holdout isolate membership changes by disabling remaining-aware progress refresh.
The first-grant gate bounds each new registered flow to one fixed BDP until a generation-tagged grant arrives.
Generation ACKs acknowledge receiver membership grants; they are not acknowledgements for every later demand update.
Passing F<=3N supports only synchronized N<=15 membership traces, not general O(N).
Performance metrics remain sealed until every holdout mechanism admission check passes.
